latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Video Creator AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create and export polished YouTube videos from video clips or images, with support for MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG (up to 500MB).
- Cloud-powered processing: combines your assets with transitions, music, and overlays using AI in 1–2 minutes; delivers 1080p MP4 output.
- Simple setup: automatic token and session management, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Upload files, describe your project, and receive a ready-to-upload YouTube video.
- Supports querying status, viewing credits, and exporting videos—all via flexible text prompts.
